system.description:
Also, at 2nd level your style thrives on switching approaches. You blend casting disciplines with such skill that your transitions become strengths, not weaknesses. First, select your Primary casting discipline keyword (Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Taijutsu and Bukijutsu). The chosen casting discipline becomes the lynchpin of your form of fighting. When you cast your Primary jutsu, you set up a strong follow up for the next jutsu. You cannot select a keyword as your Primary if your keywords casting ability modifier is lower than another casting ability modifier. (Ex. You cannot select Ninjutsu as your primary, if your Taijutsu ability modifier is higher than your Ninjutsu ability score.) When you cast your Primary casting discipline, you can choose to either Follow Up, or Set-Up.

Follow Up. One affected creature grants you a +1 bonus to hit or to your Jutsu save DC against them if the next jutsu cast affecting them is not your Primary casting discipline. This becomes a +2 a 11th and +3 at 19th level. This bonus to hit and save DC lasts until the end of your next turn.

Set-Up. All affected creatures suffers a -1 penalty to their AC or Saving throw (your choice) against the next jutsu cast from one of your allies (excluding you) before the beginning of your next turn. This becomes a -2 at 11th and -3 at 19th level.

activities.label: Follow Up
activities.text: +1 (11th +2, 19th +3) to hit or to your save DC against it with your next non-Primary jutsu.
